title: Screen definition (Program.Screen), grammar version 1
description: A screen the administrator designs: one of the platform's screen kinds (written once in code), bound to the data and the procedure it shows. Decision #165. No formula expressions: every 'when' is a plain equality on a column of the row.

menu.description: Where the screen sits in the navigation. Absent: reachable only from another screen's command.

permission.description: The permission code a person must hold for the screen to be listed and opened. The API's own checks on every read and call still decide.

view.description: schema.view, as the dispatcher serves it (GET /api/v1/<schema>/<view>).

format.description: How the cell is shown: date (day), when (day and time), state (a coloured pill), legacyFree (the migrated record number stripped).

fallback.description: A second column shown when the first is empty.

when.description: Every entry must hold: the row's column equals the value (or, with an array, is one of them).

param.description: openScreen: the row's column whose value is the screen's id parameter.

query.description: openScreen: extra query parameters, value = the row's column.

workflowKey.description: raiseRequest: the workflow to start on the new request.

scopeKind.description: raiseRequest: what the request is about.

scopeColumn.description: raiseRequest: the row's column holding the scope entity id.

titleFrom.description: raiseRequest: the row's column used in the request's title.

transition.description: transition: the transition name on the work item's request workflow.

url.description: url: a page path; {Column} placeholders are filled from the row.

when.description: Shown greyed when it does not hold.

permission.description: Shown greyed when the person does not hold it.

stationsView.description: The location list (default location.vNode with NodeTypeCode=Station).

badgeFrom.description: Another state whose rows, for the same device, mark this state's rows with a badge.

deviceColumn.description: The column that identifies the device a row belongs to (badges, compare).

rowKey.description: The column that identifies a row (default RevisionRowId).

empty.description: The group name when the column is empty.

showInstead.description: Context columns shown on the row while this grouping is on.

textFrom.description: revisionFile: the settings text filed for the row's RevisionRowId.

report.description: A page path for the location report, {StationNodeEntityId} and {GridState} filled.

options.description: Absent: the distinct values of the column.

thisMonth.description: A date column that must fall in the current month.

headerKey.description: The header view's column the screen's id parameter matches (the work request's entity id).

title.description: The header column used as the title.

notes.description: Text columns shown as blocks under the header.

tracks.description: auto: every top-level block as a row; branches: the parallel branches of the first running parallel block side by side, the rest as rows.

tracksOf.description: branches: the block path whose branches are the tracks (default: the first parallel block).

showSteps.description: Which steps are listed under a block: all, or only the ones not yet committed or skipped.

produced.description: The run's produced entities to show, with the screen that opens each.

items.description: A grid of the work item's items (the settings records of a request), read from a view by the work request id.

help.description: Extra help per capture field name.

refViews.description: For ref and set fields: per refKind, the view to pick from and its label column.

record.description: The settings record is plain code (2026-09-15 rule): the definition names its data; the rest is the component's.

key.description: The column the screen's id parameter matches.

schemaKey.description: The CharacteristicSchema definition whose characteristics are shown by DisplayGroup.

parsed.description: Show the parsed settings (document.vParsedSettingNamed) and allow Compare.

byColumn.description: The column the other revisions of the same subject share (DeviceEntityId).
